title: Git Deploy
subtitle_suffix: Connect a repo, add the deploy key to GitHub, and use the webhook URL for automatic pulls.

github.title: GitHub Connection
github.desc: Connect with a PAT → list your repos → one-click deploy + automatic webhook.
github.disconnect_confirm: The GitHub connection will be removed. Any webhook is deleted, existing repo files are unaffected.
github.auto_deploy_label: Auto-deploy on push (webhook will be set up)

repo.url_hint: Use the SSH URL for private repos; auth won't work over HTTPS.
repo.connect_success: Repo connected. Copy the deploy key and add it to your GitHub repo, then click "Clone".
repo.clone_confirm_message: The target directory ({{dir}}) content will be COMPLETELY deleted and the {{branch}} branch from the repo will be cloned. Continue?
repo.remove_confirm_message: The panel record will be deleted (cloned files remain on disk).

deployKey.title: Deploy Key (Public)
deployKey.desc: GitHub → Repository → Settings → Deploy keys → Add deploy key — paste this key (write access is NOT required).

webhook.title: Webhook (Auto Pull)
webhook.desc: GitHub → Repository → Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook. Content type: application/json. The push event is enough.
